title: pvSLACDataReader
body:
## pvSLACDataReader

Reads the NetCDF-based mesh and mode files of SLAC's accelerator electromagnetics codes (Omega3P, Tau3P and related tools). MeshFileName is the element mesh; ModeFileName is one mode file (usually an eigenmode with electric and magnetic fields) or several files forming a time series. Output port 0 (External Surface) is the boundary surface and port 1 (Entire Volume) the volume mesh, filled only when ReadInternalVolume is enabled. When a mode file stores a frequency (100 or more, treated as hertz) the complex fields are animated over one period of the lowest frequency: each mode contributes magnitude × FrequencyScale × cos(initial phase + 2πft + PhaseShift) and the modes are summed.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Port 0 is only the external surface; enable ReadInternalVolume and connect {"node": id, "port": 1} for fields inside the cavity.
- ModeFileName is optional: omit it to read the mesh alone. A bounded native probe on 2026-10-12 (ParaView 5.13.3, serial, synthetic one-tetrahedron mesh) read the mesh with ModeFileName omitted, with no error (4 points, 4 cells); it has not been run on real SLAC files.
- Mode files must use the same points as the mesh file.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this reader, so check the output on your own files.

Native constructor: `SLACDataReader`. Identity: `sources/SLACReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FrequencyScale` | Sets the scale factor for each mode. By default, each scale factor is set to 1. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `MeshFileName` | The name of the mesh file to load. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"minLength":1,"type":"string"}` | `required` | `"REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"` |
| `ModeFileName` | The name of the mode files to load. The points in the mode file should be the same as the mesh file. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `PhaseShift` | Sets the phase offset for each mode. By default, shift is set to 0. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1]` |
| `ReadExternalSurface` | If on, read the external surfaces of the data set. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReadInternalVolume` | If on, read the internal volume of the data set. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `ReadMidpoints` | If on, reads midpoint information for external surfaces and builds quadratic surface triangles. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": 2,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvSLACDataReader",
  "options": {
    "MeshFileName": "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
  }
}
```
